related_questions.question: How long do spike proteins last in the body?

text_blocks.snippet: Spike proteins generated by COVID-19 vaccines typically last in the body for a few weeks, according to Nebraska Medicine. The immune system recognizes and eliminates these proteins, as they are not part of the body's natural cells. While the mRNA in the vaccines is degraded within a few days, the spike proteins can be detected for a few weeks after vaccination. Some individuals with Post-vaccination syndrome (PVS) have shown detectable spike protein levels even more than 700 days after their last vaccination, according to YaleNews.

related_questions.question: Will there be a 2025-2026 COVID vaccine?

text_blocks.snippet: Yes, there will be a new COVID-19 vaccine formula for the 2025-2026 season in the United States. The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (.gov) has advised manufacturers to update the COVID-19 vaccines to better match currently circulating SARS-CoV-2 viruses. The recommended formula for the 2025-2026 season is a monovalent JN.1-lineage-based vaccine, with a preference for the LP. 8.1 strain. These vaccines are expected to be available in the fall of 2025.
